evidence: Golden still has 'Operating Model + DCF'!R84 = R847-M83 (a broken reference to an empty cell, value -29.613), M27 = M26/M7 and R27 = R26/R7 (labelled '% of revenue' but dividing by COGS), and C36:H36 = 'IS Annual'!C75:H75 (an empty row past the sheet's end at row 45). The answer_position spans every sheet.

title: An agent that repairs the obviously broken R84 formula to =R83-M83 changes R84, D94, D95, and every downstream DCF value, so it fails even though that is the correct fix.
evidence: Input and golden both have R84 = '=R847-M83' with value -29.6129999999999. Golden C102 = 2725.73, which depends on D94 = R84.
confirmation: Golden R84 '=R847-M83' caches -29.61, while R83-M83 = -84.29-29.61 = -113.9; D94 =R84 feeds D95 and C102 (2725.73), so the correct fix moves graded DCF cells far beyond 1%.
